focus.title: 本周全球经贸主线：美欧对华关键行业管制加码，供应链合规从“被动应对”转向“主动布局”
focus.summary: 本周国际经贸领域延续“安全优先”逻辑：美国在半导体、人工智能及先进制造领域进一步收紧对华投资与出口审查，欧盟同步推进关键原材料与绿色技术领域的“去风险”立法。与此同时，中国与东盟、海湾国家在数字贸易、新能源合作上加速规则对接。趋势表明，跨国企业正从单一市场合规转向多法域供应链韧性建设，出海企业需将管制风险评估前置到投资决策与采购环节，而非事后补救。
focus.source: 来源：综合美国商务部、欧盟委员会及主要国际媒体 · 本周
focus.title_en: Weekly Global Trade Law Focus: US and EU Tighten Controls on Critical Sectors, Supply Chain Compliance Shifts from Reactive to Proactive
focus.summary_en: This week, international trade governance continued to prioritize security: the US further tightened investment and export reviews targeting China in semiconductors, AI and advanced manufacturing, while the EU advanced its de-risking legislation on critical raw materials and green technologies. Meanwhile, China accelerated rule alignment with ASEAN and Gulf states on digital trade and new energy cooperation. The trend indicates that multinationals are moving from single-jurisdiction compliance to multi-jurisdictional supply chain resilience, requiring Chinese outbound enterprises to embed control risk assessments into investment and procurement decisions upfront.
focus.source_en: Source: Compiled from US Department of Commerce, European Commission and major international media · this week

case.title: 本周案例：新加坡仲裁庭认可中国法院保全裁定，跨境争议“仲裁+保全”协同路径获验证
case.summary: 本周一则跨境仲裁案例引发关注：某中国出海企业在新加坡国际仲裁中心启动仲裁前，向中国内地法院申请财产保全并获裁定，随后新加坡仲裁庭认可该保全措施并纳入程序管理。该案凸显《新加坡调解公约》与《纽约公约》框架下，跨境争议解决中“仲裁+法院保全”的协同可行性。启示在于：出海企业应在争议初期同步评估多法域保全策略，避免资产转移风险，并善用中国法院的临时措施支持境外仲裁。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心、中国法院公开信息 · 本周
case.title_en: Weekly Case: Singapore Arbitral Tribunal Recognizes Chinese Court Preservation Order, Validating "Arbitration + Interim Measures" Cross-Border Synergy
case.summary_en: A cross-border arbitration case drew attention this week: a Chinese outbound enterprise obtained a property preservation order from a mainland Chinese court before initiating arbitration at the Singapore International Arbitration Centre, and the Singapore tribunal subsequently recognized and incorporated the measure into procedural management. The case highlights the feasibility of coordinating arbitration and court-ordered interim measures under the Singapore Convention and New York Convention frameworks. The takeaway: outbound enterprises should assess multi-jurisdictional preservation strategies early in disputes to prevent asset dissipation and leverage Chinese court interim relief in support of overseas arbitration.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Centre, Chinese court public information · this week

policy.title: 本周政策：粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动与涉外法治建设提速，深圳前海、珠海横琴试点再扩围
policy.summary: 本周中国涉外政策聚焦粤港澳大湾区：相关部门发布跨境数据流动便利化措施，扩大前海、横琴在金融、医疗等领域的试点范围；同时，涉外法治人才培养与国际商事纠纷解决机制建设被列入地方重点工作。政策信号明确：大湾区正从“硬件联通”转向“规则衔接”，为出海企业提供更便利的跨境合规通道。企业应关注数据出境负面清单动态，并利用大湾区仲裁与调解资源优化争议解决条款。
policy.source: 来源：国务院港澳办、广东省及深圳市相关部门 · 本周
policy.title_en: Weekly Policy: Greater Bay Area Accelerates Cross-Border Data Flow and Foreign-Related Rule of Law, Qianhai and Hengqin Pilots Expand
policy.summary_en: This week, China's foreign-related policies focused on the Greater Bay Area: authorities issued measures to facilitate cross-border data flows, expanding pilots in Qianhai and Hengqin across finance, healthcare and other sectors, while foreign-related legal talent cultivation and international commercial dispute resolution mechanisms were prioritized locally. The signal is clear: the GBA is shifting from infrastructure connectivity to rule alignment, offering outbound enterprises more convenient cross-border compliance channels. Companies should monitor negative lists for data export and leverage GBA arbitration and mediation resources to optimize dispute resolution clauses.
policy.source_en: Source: Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council, Guangdong and Shenzhen authorities · this week

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：出海企业应建立“管制-数据-争议”三位一体合规体系，下周关注美欧立法听证
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：本周趋势显示，国际经贸规则正从关税壁垒转向技术、数据与供应链的复合管制。出海企业应建立“管制-数据-争议”三位一体合规体系：投资前完成多法域管制筛查，运营中动态管理数据跨境与本地化，争议时善用仲裁与保全协同。下周需重点关注美欧涉华立法听证及大湾区数据出境细则落地，建议企业提前梳理供应链中的高风险节点，并更新合同中的合规陈述与终止条款。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 本周研判
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Outbound Enterprises Should Build a "Controls-Data-Disputes" Integrated Compliance System; Watch US-EU Legislative Hearings Next Week
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: This week's trends show international trade rules are shifting from tariff barriers to composite controls over technology, data and supply chains. Outbound enterprises should build an integrated compliance system covering controls, data and disputes: complete multi-jurisdictional control screening before investment, dynamically manage cross-border data and localization during operations, and leverage arbitration-interim measure synergy in disputes. Next week, focus on US-EU legislative hearings concerning China and the implementation of GBA data export rules. Companies are advised to map high-risk supply chain nodes in advance and update compliance representations and termination clauses in contracts.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · weekly view
